newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran police seize over one tonne of drugs - IRNA.
newsitem.headline: Iran police seize over one tonne of drugs - IRNA.

text.p: Iranian police have seized more than one tonne of narcotics in the northeastern province of Khorasan, Iran's official news agency IRNA said on Sunday.
In five separate busts, police confiscated a total of 1,024 kg (2,260 lb) of narcotics from 23 smugglers along with an unspecified number of firearms.
Iran is a key transit route for drugs, mostly opium from which heroin is made, being smuggled to Europe via Turkey from Afghanistan and Pakistan -- the so-called "Golden Crescent".
Tehran has said police seized 175 tonnes of drugs in the Iranian year which ended on March 20.
More than 1,000 people have been executed in Iran since a 1989 law took effect imposing the death sentence for possession of five kg (11 lb) of opium or 30 grams (just over one ounce) of heroin.
